entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted SDK and server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This official Hermes provider offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated significant task-completion gains during LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee implements a self-hosted knowledge graph engine to provide agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers native clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain builds knowledge graphs using typed edges without requiring LLM calls for graph construction. It focuses on generating cited prose answers with explicit gap analysis while maintaining scoped institutional memory through per-user data isolation.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official Hermes provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall at high scale. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while utilizing byte-level deduplication to achieve a 100% prompt-cache discount.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents across more than 25 LLM providers. It supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud and provides SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho serves as the core FastAPI-based library for building stateful agents and session management. It functions as the upstream dependency for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper and supports managed or local deployment.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider treats memory as a git repository, utilizing version control actions like commit, branch, and merge over a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that achieves sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database. It integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI and requires only Python 3.10 or higher.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a local infrastructure of Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the Hermes Agent prioritizes specific injected context and auto-curated wiki data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and playbooks. It uses outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes for complex agent tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents by using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local agent history files to enable retroactive search across months of past sessions. It provides MCP tools for natural-language recall and context automation while redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for flexible infrastructure deployment.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains a living semantic ontology with audit trails to raw sources. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy and offers portable state across Hermes Agent and other coding clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores data as human-readable YAML files on local disk using an open engram format. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25 and local embeddings for retrieval through MCP-integrated tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, and integrates via MCP, plugins, and specific agent hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and save up to 36% in tokens. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord or Telegram.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing memory as inspectable Markdown files. It runs locally without a daemon or telemetry, utilizing DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for cross-project memory.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. It manages state and retrieval through a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs using local-first storage and GGUF models. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It utilizes a local-first architecture with SQLite and FTS5 and supports the Model Context Protocol via stdio and SSE.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider enables reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search integration.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25-first retrieval and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer provides durable context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using Markdown files as the source of truth. It features a migration workflow for importing project instructions and chat histories into a structured context format.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that addresses persistent recall issues by supporting real, immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, using USDC and other stablecoins. It facilitates direct wallet settlement with 0% transaction fees for frameworks like Hermes and elizaOS.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP server configurations to improve agent routing. It offers tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing feedback loops to refine local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It features a local SQLite reliability layer with a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports manual memory storage and advanced retrieval features like configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory of markdown files. It features five slash commands for capturing and recalling information while generating evidence-cited diffs for manual review and JSON output.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology for autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports macOS and Windows desktop applications. It generates documents and decks using real CSS and components, offering integration with Claude Code and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for comprehensive security task coverage.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also enforces architecture contracts using Diagram-as-Test and YAML/JSON rules.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for payments and escrow. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to manage natural-language mandates and delegated permissions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that integrates natively with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for agents compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation directory.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The skills are distributed as plain markdown files under an MIT license for easy export to other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other tools to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports platforms including Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds via integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency. It enables modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts, while supporting programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It features a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool enables literate programming by weaving code and documentation into .lit.md files containing prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs source file edits back to the literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed as a harness for long-running agents, this project utilizes a mechanism kernel, plugins, and Markdown-based recipes. It manages work through durable trees and layered proof verification while implementing the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, these skills support integration with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The package includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to enable oracle network and smart contract interaction.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format along with installation and configuration guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard for the Brazilian community.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX 3 video and image generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video generation workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from code, documentation, and developer discourse to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It links instructions to specific source lines or URLs and includes lifecycle tooling for testing and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification through a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary to execute AI workflows. It audits cost ceilings, secret flows, and types before token expenditure and generates hash-chained receipts for verifiable run history.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for efficiency, reducing token usage while offering graceful degradation if embedding models are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only bug-hunting skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial code reviews and edge-case analysis. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly execution system that manages habits and study blocks through agent-driven scheduling via MCP. It stores data locally in SQLite and provides user interfaces through both a React web portal and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three specialized agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified investigation protocols to Hermes, utilizing multi-story task decomposition with evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables progressive disclosure of capabilities via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI to support tool-based skill loading and automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide Hermes with session management and worktree recovery tools to maintain memory between conversations. The project also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for building new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects frontmatter drift. It monitors official specifications weekly to ensure skills remain compliant with current runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind a framework of deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set facilitates deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. it ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments upon human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales, from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos to Markdown and performing OCR on invoices and contracts. It also includes a writing engine designed to adjust text tone and style by removing AI-typical patterns.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from providers like OpenAI and DeepSeek. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need current development tools packaged for the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing for mobile agent interaction.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools and persistent memory, allowing the agent to interface with both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on cloud-native state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on security by sandboxing the agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora acts as a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides management features such as per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and cost monitoring accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed knowledge graph of codebases to reduce token consumption and tool calls for coding agents. It features automatic synchronization upon file changes and provides structural extraction for languages including TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI utility tracks token usage across various AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code. Users can monitor their consumption through a 3D visualization dashboard and submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer designed for inspecting API traffic from coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, supporting tools like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from terminal interfaces. It supports over 35 tools and offers multi-device synchronization alongside historical usage breakdowns by project and model.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project provides custom themes and skins for the Hermes terminal user interface. Users can configure banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration files.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform that enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing users to switch between default and scoped agents seamlessly. It supports project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions to provide agents with specific skills based on the local configuration.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a production-ready stack at zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts without using LLMs. It flags vague tool descriptions and missing retry budgets while integrating with GitHub Actions and Hermes Agent verification hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility maps OpenClaw configurations, skills, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to facilitate the transition to Hermes Agent.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue through Hermes Agent. It includes a bounded JSON adapter and requires explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A fully local voice assistant for Hermes Agent that supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking with barge-in capabilities. It operates offline without the need for API keys or accounts, utilizing Piper and Kokoro for speech processing.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage for agent memories. It includes tools for adding and deleting memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, serves as an all-in-one desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified management solution compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source coworking application that consolidates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. The platform features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms like Telegram and Discord. It tracks token consumption and execution history while storing session data in a local SQLite database.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other coding agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for organizing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports native file dialogs, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It features site-aware drafting in 31 environments and live browser control governed by explicit user approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables real-time chat and server file system browsing without the use of subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks live quota burn for Codex and Claude across 14+ agent formats. It operates entirely locally with no telemetry, offering searchable transcripts and image browsing without uploading session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface connects to Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a text-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard functions as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes with local or cloud models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. Users can manage skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through an integrated file browser and task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and streaming SSE chat responses.
